description: Instantiate a curated, ready-to-run full-screen GLSL shader (tunnel, raymarch_sphere, fractal, metaballs, plasma) into a GLSL TOP with live Speed / Scale / Color controls. High-value VJ eye-candy; unlike create_glsl_shader it ships robust built-in shaders rather than taking arbitrary code.

color.description: Base color as hex (e.g. '#33ccff'); parsed to 0..1 RGB and exposed as 'Color'.

expose_controls.description: Expose live Speed / Scale / Color controls on the system container.

parent_path.description: Parent COMP path the self-contained 'shader_lib_<shader>' container is created inside.

resolution.description: Output resolution [width, height] of the GLSL TOP.

scale.description: Pattern scale/zoom multiplier (uScale). Exposed as a live 'Scale' control.

shader.description: Which curated built-in shader to instantiate.

speed.description: Animation speed multiplier (drives uTime). Exposed as a live 'Speed' control.

name: create_shader_lib
title: Create shader from library
